channel.title: Crypto Capital Monitor
channel.description: Independent crypto news and explainers for funds and trading desks, tracing capital flows, derivatives positioning and the mechanics behind market moves.

item.title: Slippage Settings Decide Which Trades Reach Settlement
item.description: A slippage limit sets the worst fill a trader accepts, trading protection from poor execution against failed transactions, gas costs and liquidation risk.

item.title: Classifying Wallet Behavior Requires Transaction Context
item.description: Wallet labels become useful only when analysts reconstruct transaction sequences, counterparties and balance changes before inferring intent or risk.

item.title: SoFi-Kraken Link Adds 24/7 Cash, Not New Credit
item.description: SoFi and Payward will connect Kraken to 24/7 dollar settlement and Prime routing, widening execution access without erasing collateral demands.

item.title: Bitcoin ETF Inflows Hit $987 Million as Trading Volume Falls
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs drew $986.9 million in a third winning week, but lower turnover shows creations expanded fund capacity, not market depth.

item.title: Light Clients Verify Blockchains in Three Checks
item.description: Light clients verify headers, consensus signatures, and state proofs with little bandwidth, but their trust assumptions still matter to operators.

item.title: Bridge Aggregators Optimize Routes, Not Just Fees
item.description: Bridge aggregators compare routes across liquidity pools, relayers and chains, but the cheapest quote can hide latency, trust assumptions and failure costs.

item.title: SoFi-Payward Deal Puts 24/7 Dollars Beside Kraken Liquidity
item.description: SoFi’s SEN and SoFiUSD will connect to Kraken’s trading rails, shortening settlement gaps while concentrating more market plumbing in two firms.

item.title: Harmony’s ONE Migration to Ethereum Tests Its Last Validators
item.description: Harmony proposes ending its layer 1 and reissuing ONE on Ethereum, but the plan shifts security, fees and migration risk from validators to holders.

item.title: Ethena Pay Turns USDe Into a High-Yield Spending Account
